title: Close and continue in another project
description: Finish this task as it stands and start the rest of the work in another project.
explain: “{{title}}” will be completed with the time already recorded on it. A new task takes up the remaining work.
rule1: The new task is blocked by this one, so you can always find where it came from.
rule2: Only the name and the project carry over (and the assignee); everything else starts from the project's defaults, with no time recorded.
rule3: The finished task keeps its time and stays counted in the period it belongs to.
